# gitea_team_repository (Data Source)

Gets a repository attached to a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_team_repository" "example" {
  team_id          = 1
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.
- `team_id` (Number) The team ID.

### Read-Only

- `default_branch` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `html_url` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `private` (Boolean)
